_not: The Drowned Queen: Harita 2 final bossu (Throne of Brine dr_82; maps-2-3.md 3.3, content-designer 2026-10-27). Ödünç Lord Morvane kiti yerine kendi kiti: Brine Lash (tek, her sıra, Soaked) + High Tide (belgedeki Call the Tide: telgraflı 2x2, faz 2+ 2x3, Flooded) + Lament of the Deep (tüm kahramanlar Slow + Spellbound) + ult The Reach Drowns (faz 3, tüm tahta, güvenli hücre yok). Pasif Crown of Salt: belgedeki 'tahtadaki her Flooded hücre %2 hasar azaltma' motorda yok; en yakın var olan sürüm Crown of Ash'in aynası (dost ölünce maks canın %10'u kalkan; open-questions 435). Faz 3'te Drowned Champion %50 canla yeniden kalkar (phases riseAllies). Stat / can / fazlar Morvane'le aynı. Sanat: kendi çizimi; skill ikon/efekt YER TUTUCU (artOf Morvane skill'leri). Sayılar PROVİZYON.
name: The Drowned Queen
role: Boss · Queen of the Sunken Court

passive.name: Crown of Salt
passive.text: Every Flooded cell on the battlefield (both sides) makes the Queen take 2% less damage.

boss.where: sits the Throne of Brine at the end of the Drowned Reach
notes: Warnings: High Tide and The Reach Drowns do not hit at once. The marked cells fill with water and the attack lands at the start of the Queen's next turn, before she acts. Every hero gets at least one turn in between. These hits cannot miss.
High Tide marks a block of cells: move out of it (Move). From phase 2 the block is wider.
The Reach Drowns marks your whole side and has no safe cell: shield, guard, fortify or heal your heroes before it lands.
At 30% HP the Drowned Champion rises again at her side if it has fallen.

passives.name: Crown of Salt
passives.text: Every Flooded cell on the battlefield (both sides) makes the Queen take 2% less damage. Her own floods armour her: fight her when the water recedes.

passives.name: Drowning Crown
passives.text: At 60% HP the tide turns: High Tide grows to 2x3. At 30% the Reach drowns with her: she acts twice a turn, her hits deal 15% more damage, at once she calls The Reach Drowns and her fallen Champion rises again with half its HP. A single attack can cross only one of these thresholds.
